dec.n: Yean and Bosico Girls v. Dominican Republic
dec.pe: Two girls born in the Dominican Republic to families of Haitian descent were refused birth certificates, leaving them without any nationality. The Inter-American Court said this was discrimination and that children do not inherit their parents’ migration status.
dec.pi: Dua anak perempuan yang lahir di Republik Dominika dari keluarga keturunan Haiti ditolak akta kelahirannya, sehingga tidak punya kewarganegaraan. Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika menyatakan ini diskriminasi dan anak tidak mewarisi status migrasi orang tuanya.

dec.n: Nadège Dorzema et al. v. Dominican Republic
dec.pe: Soldiers fired on a truck carrying Haitian migrants near the border, killing seven people. Survivors were sent back to Haiti without any hearing. The Inter-American Court said the Dominican Republic violated their rights and must not expel migrants as a group.
dec.pi: Tentara menembaki truk yang membawa migran Haiti di dekat perbatasan, menewaskan tujuh orang. Korban selamat dipulangkan ke Haiti tanpa pemeriksaan. Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika menyatakan Republik Dominika melanggar hak mereka dan tidak boleh mengusir migran secara berkelompok.

dec.n: Sentencia TC/0168/13 (nationality of children of foreign residents)
dec.ct: Constitutional Tribunal of the Dominican Republic
dec.pe: A woman born in the Dominican Republic to Haitian parents was refused her identity card. The Constitutional Tribunal said children of migrants without papers were never Dominican, going back to 1929. Tens of thousands of people, mostly of Haitian descent, risked losing their nationality.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan yang lahir di Republik Dominika dari orang tua Haiti ditolak kartu identitasnya. MK menyatakan anak migran tanpa dokumen tidak pernah menjadi warga Dominika, berlaku surut sampai 1929. Puluhan ribu orang, kebanyakan keturunan Haiti, terancam kehilangan kewarganegaraan.

dec.n: Expelled Dominicans and Haitians v. Dominican Republic
dec.pe: People of Haitian descent, many born in the Dominican Republic, were rounded up and sent to Haiti. The Inter-American Court said this broke their rights and that the 2013 nationality ruling must be undone. The Dominican Republic refused and rejected the Court’s authority.
dec.pi: Orang keturunan Haiti, banyak yang lahir di Republik Dominika, ditangkap dan dikirim ke Haiti. Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika menyatakan ini melanggar hak mereka dan putusan kewarganegaraan 2013 harus dibatalkan. Republik Dominika menolak dan tidak mengakui kewenangan Pengadilan.
